messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body orbit shot that starts in front, circles the person through 360 degrees, and returns to the front view. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a full-body orbit shot that starts in front, circles the person through 360 degrees, and returns to the front view. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then turns in a slow circle, raising her arms briefly before returning to a front-facing standing pose.","camera":"A full-body shot that orbits around the character at a low angle, keeping her centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white, short-sleeved romper with a pink and yellow floral pattern and red slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short, straight blue hair with bangs and small buns or pigtails at the back.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, dark skin, and a youthful face.","scene":"An outdoor, sunlit plaza with cracked stone paving, surrounded by weathered, tan-colored buildings and wooden crates."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins with a front full-body view matching the reference framing, then the camera orbits around the character, showing side and back views before returning to the front. The character remains in the same plaza and performs a similar standing/turning motion.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body 360-degree orbit that starts in front, circles the character, and returns to the front, using the reference for initial framing while preserving the character, action, and scene.
uncertain: Whether the orbit completes a full 360 degrees or only a partial circle before returning to the front.
unexpected_changes: The background appears more heavily stylized and distorted during parts of the orbit, with warped building textures and less coherent scene detail than the source.
